# Unsuccessful Compilation Handling

The failure to compile causes the system to rollback the session and set the run status to 'failed', highlighting the need for robust error management to maintain system integrity.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run._compile_one`
